tickets.title: Follow up on missing signature

tickets.title: Prepare retirement income plan
tickets.text: Create a retirement income plan that identifies expected spending needs, reliable income sources, portfolio withdrawal strategy, tax considerations, reserve targets, and implementation actions. Use current client data and clearly note assumptions, risks, and follow-up items. Build the model for Elias and Lena Copperwisp using household spending of about $11,800 per month, Elias's expected mid-2027 departure from Clockwork Clover Design, Lena's planned freelance wind-down around 2030, Social Security estimates of about $3,050 (Elias) and $2,100 (Lena) at full retirement age, transferred assets, tax projections, and reserve targets.

subTasks.title: Model withdrawal and tax-aware sequencing

subTasks.title: Align portfolio and cash reserve strategy

Identify trades, cash raises, or rebalancing actions needed to support the income plan, including the roughly nine-month cash reserve preference during the account transition.
